briefdescription.para: Add subsystem permission bits to a reset's runtime entry.

detaileddescription.para: A runtime list and entry are allocated when needed. Existing permissions are preserved and combined with AllowSubsystems.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the reset node to update

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_INVALID_PARAM for a NULL reset, or XST_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL if runtime storage cannot be allocated

briefdescription.para: Retrieve a reset node's stored subsystem permission bits.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the reset node to look up
Pointer to receive the permission bit mask

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_INVALID_PARAM for a NULL argument, or XST_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND when no runtime entry exists for the reset

briefdescription.para: Perform a reset action on the reset node identified by ResetId.

parameterdescription.para: Node ID of the reset to operate on
Reset action to apply (assert, de-assert or pulse)

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, error code otherwise

briefdescription.para: Read the hardware assertion state of a reset node.

parameterdescription.para: Required non-NULL pointer to receive 1 when all reset bits are asserted, or 0 otherwise

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, or XST_INVALID_PARAM when the reset node does not exist

briefdescription.para: Checks whether the given reset may be operated on.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if permitted, error code otherwise

briefdescription.para: Grant the subsystem secure and non-secure permission for every reset in the global permission-reset list.

parameterdescription.para: Subsystem to be given the reset permissions

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, error code otherwise

memberdef.argsstring: (const u32 SubsystemId, const XPm_ResetNode *Rst, const u32 CmdType)
memberdef.name: XPmReset_IsOperationAllowed

briefdescription.para: Find the runtime permission entry associated with a reset node.

detaileddescription.para: Keep list traversal in one place so permission updates and queries use the same matching and NULL-entry handling.

simplesect.para: Matching runtime entry, or NULL when none exists.
